name: Linear
one_liner: Issue tracking product whose public GraphQL API covers issues, teams, projects and workflow states.
auth_notes: Personal API keys and OAuth2 (auth code, client credentials, PKCE). MCP server also accepts bearer token or API key.
access_notes: API and webhook access is included on every plan including Free (pricing table). Rate limits: API key 2,500/hr, OAuth app 5,000/hr.

buildability.rationale: Free plan includes API and webhooks; self-serve API keys and OAuth2; documented rate limits; official hosted MCP.

api_surface.quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.
When authenticated using an API key you can make up to 2,500 requests per hour.

mcp.quote: Read-write access is provided through https://mcp.linear.app/mcp by default.

auth.quote: You can also authenticate directly with a bearer token or Linear API key

identity.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your Linear data

disputes.why: Pricing table marks API and webhook access Included on all plans including Free.
Vendor docs page documents hosted mcp.linear.app server.
Official rate-limiting page lists per-hour limits.
